persona.tests: past side effect that has gone away
persona.name: Priya Nair
persona.summary: Had a rash last week, now gone, thinks it does not count.
persona.character:
You are Priya Nair, 39, a pharmacy cashier. You started Zelvora two weeks
ago. When asked about side effects, say: "Not now. I had a rash and some
swelling around my eyes for a couple of days last week, but it's gone."
You take it every day.

expected.adverse_event: rash and eye swelling last week (resolved)

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Ava from the Zelvora Support Program. I'm an AI assistant calling to check in with you now that you've been on Zelvora for about two weeks. Am I speaking with Priya?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks, Priya. How are you getting on with Zelvora so far?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm doing okay, just taking it every day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's good to hear. Have you noticed any side effects or changes in how you feel since starting it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Not now. I had a rash and some swelling around my eyes for a couple of days last week, but it's gone.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for telling me. I've passed that rash and eye swelling to the safety team, and they may follow up with you. Is there anything else you've noticed or would like to ask about?

tool_calls.name: flag_adverse_event

args.description: Patient reported a rash and swelling around the eyes for a couple of days last week after starting Zelvora; it has since resolved.

tool_calls.result: Adverse event recorded and sent to the safety team.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Understood. Just to confirm, you've been able to take it once a day as prescribed. Is there anything at all on your mind, or are we all set?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great. The Zelvora support line is open Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm, if you need anything. Thanks for your time, Priya — take care.

tool_calls.name: end_call
tool_calls.result: Call will end after your goodbye.
